paper_title: DLP Dynamic Layerwise Pruning in Large Language Models
caption: Perplexity of LLaMA1-7B on different validation datasets under varying quantization bits.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: This figure consists of three grouped bar charts, labeled (a) WikiText, (b) PTB, and (c) C4, illustrating the perplexity of LLaMA1-7B on different validation datasets under varying quantization bits. Each sub-chart shares the same structure: the horizontal axis is labeled "Quantization Bits" and displays four categories in the order 3, 4, 8, and 16, while the vertical axis is labeled "Perplexity" with a linear scale. In chart (a) WikiText, the perplexity axis ranges from 0 to 30 with increments of 5; in chart (b) PTB, it ranges from 0 to 400 with increments of 50; and in chart (c) C4, it ranges from 0 to 30 with increments of 10. Each category on the horizontal axis contains two bars side by side: a blue bar representing "Uniform" and an orange bar representing "Ours," as indicated by a legend positioned in the upper-left corner of each sub-chart. In chart (a) WikiText, the blue bars have approximate values of 29, 27, 26.5, and 26.5 for quantization bits 3, 4, 8, and 16 respectively, while the orange bars show approximate values of 22, 19, 18.5, and 18.5. In chart (b) PTB, the blue bars show approximate values of 400, 320, 295, and 295 for quantization bits 3, 4, 8, and 16 respectively, while the orange bars show approximate values of 245, 180, 180, and 178. In chart (c) C4, the blue bars show approximate values of 28, 25, 24.5, and 24.5 for quantization bits 3, 4, 8, and 16 respectively, while the orange bars show approximate values of 21, 18.5, 18.5, and 18.5. Across all three sub-charts, the bars within each category are not sorted by value but are consistently ordered with the blue (Uniform) bar on the left and the orange (Ours) bar on the right. No bars are visually emphasized through special outlining, shading differences, or additional annotations beyond the legend labels.
